title: Written Offer Terms by Grade — Trade-In Agreements
content:
The terms below govern how long a written offer under **Trade-In Agreements** can be accepted, what an acceptance must carry, and how an accepted trade may be tied to a Kestrel purchase. They are stated for each condition grade.

| Term | Inoperable | Rough | Fair | Good | Very Good | Excellent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Offer validity (calendar days after the offer date, offer date being day 0) | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 |
| A lapsed or declined offer can be replaced by a new offer on request | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Acceptance of a financed or leased vehicle requires the lienholder name and loan account number | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| A leased vehicle may be traded, its lease payoff treated as the lien | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Kestrel buys the vehicle without a linked purchase (outright sale) | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Maximum trade-in agreements linked to one purchase order | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Latest purchase order status in which a trade can be linked | contracted | contracted | contracted | contracted | contracted | contracted |

## Terms read in full

1. **Validity.** An offer can be accepted on any calendar day from its offer date through the 7th calendar day after it; that last day is the offer expiration date shown on the agreement.
2. **Refresh.** A customer whose offer has lapsed or been declined may ask for a new offer. The new offer is a new agreement with its own amount, grade and dates.
3. **Liens and leases.** Where the vehicle carries a loan or a lease, acceptance carries the lienholder or lessor name and the loan account number. A leased vehicle may be traded at every grade.
4. **Outright sale and purchase link.** At every grade the vehicle may be sold to Kestrel without a purchase, or linked to a purchase order. No more than 2 trade-in agreements may be linked to one purchase order, and the latest order status in which the link can be made is contracted.

## Illustration (hypothetical dates)

An offer dated the 3rd of a month is acceptable through the end of the 10th of that month (day 7). On the 11th the offer can no longer be accepted, and only a new offer can take its place.
